sv.title: Equinor har stoppat cyberattack
sv.summary: Cyberattacken som det norska oljebolaget Equinor upptäckte den 17 november har nu stoppats. Det skriver bolaget i en uppdatering.

en.title: Equinor has stopped cyberattack
en.summary: The cyberattack that the Norwegian oil company Equinor discovered on 17 November has now been stopped. The company writes in an update.
